$comment: Topic-wise table of contents (সূচিপত্র) per chapter, built by tools/build-toc.mjs into content/toc.json. By default a chapter's topics are its MCQ topics in book order; 'topics' overrides that list, 'exclude' drops mixed sets (e.g. self-tests). Every other item is placed under the topic whose MCQs it reads most like; notes PDFs and simulations stay chapter-wide.
